images.prompt:
Original hand-painted festive watercolour stationery illustration on subtly textured warm-white paper, with transparent layered pigment, gentle dry-brush marks and fine selective charcoal-pencil detail rather than bold outlines. Use moderate focal detail, generous breathing room, soft wintery light, muted evergreen, sage, cranberry, warm brown, cream and blue-grey hues, delicate cool shadows and a warm nostalgic handmade mood. Characters, where present, are softly naturalistic and storybook-like, with rounded forms, subtle faces and restrained gestures; preserve clear hierarchy and home-print-friendly tonal contrast.

STYLE PARAMETERS: illustration style: Hand-painted festive watercolour stationery with original botanical and winter storytelling motifs, balancing a refined handmade feel with clear card-front readability.; line weight: Very fine, selective charcoal-pencil or ink accents; no heavy outlines.; line quality: Gently irregular, organic and hand-rendered, used sparingly to define small details.; detail level: Moderate detail concentrated in one clear focal illustration, with secondary marks kept airy and restrained for reliable home printing.; character language: Softly naturalistic storybook characters with rounded silhouettes, subtle facial features and understated expressive gestures.; background density: Predominantly clean warm-white space; any scenic detail is contained, lightly layered and allowed to recede behind the focal point.; composition: Centred or softly asymmetrical focal hierarchy with generous breathing room and a clearly reserved area for an original greeting; framed vignettes may use broad unprinted borders.; palette: Muted heritage Christmas palette of evergreen, sage, olive, cranberry, brick red, warm brown, cream, soft grey and frosty blue-grey; red used as a restrained accent.; colour mode: full colour; shading: Transparent layered washes with gentle wet-on-dry modelling, soft cool winter shadows and occasional warm accents; never glossy or digitally airbrushed.; texture: Fine cold-pressed paper grain, mottled watercolour pigment, delicate dry-brush foliage marks and subtle hand-painted variation.; mood: Warm, nostalgic, peaceful and quietly celebratory..

PAGE 1 of "Christmas Conservatory" (card-front): Portrait Christmas card front. Exact title text: “Merry Christmas” in a spacious classic serif at upper centre. A softly asymmetrical lower-left botanical vignette: exactly three clementines gathered with a muted cranberry velvet ribbon, cedar sprigs, pine sprigs, two pinecones, olive leaves and a few restrained cranberry berries. Keep the upper half open and the arrangement light and graceful, with foliage rising softly inward from the corner.

CANVAS: A single portrait design with a solid or softly textured coloured background. Keep a clear margin on every side; nothing important touches the edges, so it prints cleanly on a home printer. It must look like a finished, retail-quality greeting card design, not a colouring page or worksheet. Design three coordinated portrait panels for an A4 or US Letter folded card, with a warm-white ground, broad safe margins, and no essential artwork near folds or trim. Any printed text must be short, correctly spelled and exactly as quoted.

DO NOT INCLUDE: Any copied reference-card artwork, layouts, icon grids, motifs, characters, message wording or drawn lettering; The reference mouse potting-bench scene, its props, clothing, staging or composition; Logos, trademarks, interfaces, product-photography props, hands, envelopes and mock-up elements; Photorealism, glossy 3D rendering, harsh black outlines or neon seasonal colours; Overcrowded card fronts, full-bleed dark backgrounds and detail too fine for home printing; Misspelled text, illegible greetings or unlicensed fonts.
